item.title: Saudi Arabia’s King Salman slams targeting of Mecca by ‘terrorist’ Houthis
item.description: Saudi monarch's rare condemnation hints at sense of urgency in the kingdom amid ramped-up attacks from Yemen.

item.title: Trump: US-Iran meeting at UN was ‘very good’
item.description: US President Donald Trump says he had a ‘very good’ three-hour meeting with Iranian officials at the UN.

item.title: Qatar’s emir urges diplomacy as Gulf at ‘one of the most dangerous phases’
item.description: Sheikh Tamim says years of delayed diplomacy led to the US-Israel war on Iran.

item.title: Qatar urges diplomacy, rejects Strait of Hormuz ‘bargaining’
item.description: Qatari Emir Sheikh Tamim bin Hamad Al Thani called for the reopening of the Strait of Hormuz while speaking at the UN.

item.title: US, Iran hold ‘very good’ talks, Trump says at UN meeting
item.description: US President hints at possible deal with Iran, but warns of dire consequences if no agreement is reached.

item.title: Trump threatens to 'annihilate' Iran in UN speech as officials meet on sidelines
item.description: In his speech, the US president pondered whether a peace deal would be agreed or whether he would have to take extreme action against Iran.

item.title: How Ceuta, football and Israel are shaping Morocco's election
item.description: Young voters are being courted with football slogans, promises of jobs and anti-Israel rallying calls.

item.title: Sri Lanka court convicts 15 men over deadly Easter Sunday bombings
item.description: Three churches and three luxury hotels were targeted in the 2019 attacks which killed 270.

item.title: Iran must stop arming Houthis in Yemen, G7 says ahead of UN General Assembly
item.description: The G7 also condemns "in the strongest terms" Houthi attacks on Saudi Arabia, saying that the escalation in fighting in Yemen jeopardises global energy security.

item.title: Neutral venues and no 'away' fans - how Israel v Republic of Ireland became so contentious
item.description: BBC Sport explores the backdrop to the Republic of Ireland's matches against Israel, amid fraught tensions between the nations.
